note: Thursday A, workplace English（职场英语）: 事 si6 ×3. No BBC (Thu). Hard recall first (en-0182, 0185, 0186, 0188, 0189): prompt only, say each aloud before flipping, then a from-memory run-through. Recap of recent workplace cards (recap26). No new cards (Hard still sticky; no Wed 25 A result logged). Then a 30–60 sec status note before you step out this afternoon (point → reason → example). 加油！

tasks.prompt: Warm-up: say 事 (si6, low flat tone 低平调) three times in a row. Low and flat, not mid like 試 si3, not falling like 時 si4.
tasks.script: 事 si6 · 事 si6 · 事 si6 (試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls; 事 si6 sits low and flat)

tasks.prompt: From memory: run through both Hard sets again. For the recap line, say it in 3 beats (point / reason / example). For the four words, say the word and its meaning. No peeking first, then check the script.
tasks.script:
Point: Just to recap.
Reason: So we both leave with the same plan.
Example: I'll send the draft by noon, and you'll review it tomorrow.

off your plate — pass a task or problem from your workload to someone else
frazzled — tired, nervous or anxious because you have too many things at once
the done thing — what you are expected to do in this situation
miffed — slightly annoyed by how someone treated you

tasks.prompt: Workplace output, 30–60 sec: a short status note before you step out this afternoon. “Here's where things stand, and when I'll be back online.” Point → reason → example. Say it aloud before opening the script.
tasks.script:
Point: I'll be away this afternoon, so here's a short status before I step out.
Reason: I want you to have a clear picture of where things stand, and when I'll be back online.
Example: This morning I'll finish the current check. If anything is still open, I'll flag it in the note and pick it up tomorrow morning.

questions.explain: 事 si6 is low and flat. 低平调。試 si3 is mid; 時 si4 falls.

questions.q: Fill in: Just to ___: I'll send the draft by noon, and you'll review it tomorrow.
questions.explain: Just to recap = 会议收尾复述，确认双方下一步。

questions.q: If you get a task off your plate, you…
options: keep it on your to-do list a bit longer
pass it from your workload to someone else
finish it after hours without telling anyone
questions.explain: off your plate = 把任务从自己的待办里交给别人处理。

questions.q: A short status note before you step out should cover…
options: where things stand, and when you'll be back online
a full recap of last month
questions.explain: 出门前先说清：目前进展 + 何时回到线上。

questions.q: Best order for the status note?
questions.explain: 先说重点，再讲原因，最后举例。
